title: Anyone want to use my economic calendar event data in their AI trading flows?
author: SellSideShort
selftext:
Hey guys, ex-institutional trader / market maker here. 

I've been building out what I consider to be a better version of the classic economic event calendar, ie CPI/NFP/Jobless claims etc, and wondering if anyone would like to collaborate and incorporate my model into their existing AI trading flows? If so, I would be willing to either give people free access to the front end or may build an API and handle it that way, tbd. 

My version goes beyond showing you when CPI or NFP drops, it uses a proprietary statistical consensus model built from historical data patterns, then layers AI-powered (Claude) scenario analysis on top of every event, generating specific bull, bear, and base case outcomes with estimated market moves before the data is released.   
  
Each scenario is mapped directly to the holdings defined in your watchlist, telling you exactly how your positions are exposed and what to do in each outcome. Where a traditional calendar shows you "CPI at 8:30am, consensus 0.2%," goMacro shows you "if CPI prints hot, SPY drops 1.5% and TLT sells off, here's how to position; if it prints cold, here's the rate-cut rally trade."   
  
The analysis also synthesizes views from 35+ named macro strategists via real-time web search, cross-references with live VIX, yield curve, and credit spread data, and delivers an institutional-grade briefing that updates dynamically, the kind of pre-event preparation that big institutions and hedge funds build internally and customize on a per-desk, per-mandate basis.

comments.author: droidshooter
comments.body: Hi, I’m trying to build something to help make trading decisions. I would be interested in learning more. If you can send me some information I can see if it is something that I could integrate with my idea. Thanks
